text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the day off, Trainer. Rest
assured, I
put it to good use.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I've finally cleared away all of those
errands I had
piling up!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
That doesn't mean I didn't allow myself
to
recover, of course. Physically, it was a
welcome
reprieve.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And as for mentally... There's no better
way to
unwind than spending a break
doing what you
enjoy, wouldn't you
agree?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Симболи Рудольф spent her
day off
doing what she does best.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
